  WHY: The skip does not trigger in that supported configuration, so a heal is dispatched for the deliberately parked remediation. Reviewer labelled it MAJOR.

  WHY: The new guard can park an issue that the companion rules do not classify as a remediation. The direction is fail-safe, and the reviewers labelled it NIT.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:5534 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: PRIOR_PR_BASELINE_BRANCH is keyed only on steps.baseline_refctx.outputs.branch, so the guard is skipped (outcome=allow reason=prior_pr_baseline) even when checkout_baseline failed and the run fell back to the default ref.
  WHY: A remediation issue with only docs/tests/fragments staged gets a PR opened, which is the 2026-11 audit failure this PR exists to stop. Suggested fix: gate on steps.checkout_baseline.outcome == 'success'.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_report.sh:185-196 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The remediation_no_code_park jq filter requires the author to be the reporter's login and the marker to be the last non-empty line. With AI_COMMENT_SIGNING_SECRET set, the signing shim posts the comment as github-actions[bot] with a signature line after the marker.
  WHY: The skip does not trigger, so a heal is dispatched for the deliberately parked remediation. A correct fix needs signature-aware matching.
- HARDENING scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh:266-271 | risk=1
  PROBLEM: The failed-post warning discards gh's stderr, so the log does not show why the post failed.
  WHY: Capture and truncate stderr in the warning, keeping a single attempt and exit status 0.
- HARDENING scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh:280-285,333-335 | risk=2
  PROBLEM: SCOPE_COMMENT_POSTED_BEFORE_LABEL=true is set unconditionally after the first post, so a failed post is never retried and the reason=remediation-no-code marker never exists.
  WHY: Set the flag only on a successful post so the post-label block can retry. A retry after a failed post cannot duplicate a comment.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
